title: Critical States Preparation With Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: The fast and efficient preparation of quantum critical states is a challenging yet crucial task for various quantum technologies. This difficulty is most particularly for systems near a quantum phase transition, where the closure of the energy gap fundamentally limits the timescale of adiabatic processes and thus precludes rapid state preparation. We propose a framework using deep reinforcement learning (DRL) to rapidly prepare quantum critical states, with broad extendibility to light-matter interaction systems.
